verdict.rationale: Raygun's own AI Error Resolution feature generates in-product AI suggestions on the root cause of errors and how to fix them. It uses a collaborative chat that is auto-prompted with stack trace, environment and code context, powered by OpenAI or Azure OpenAI. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of suggestion quality, AI insights beyond crash reporting (e.g. RUM/APM data), and a built-in model that needs no user-supplied OpenAI API key.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Resolve issues with unprecedented speed and accuracy using AI-powered suggestions on the root cause of errors and how to fix them.
This feature allows you to identify and tackle errors swiftly with just a click, using advanced AI technology powered by OpenAI and Azure OpenAI.
Auto-prompt your chosen LLM with crucial error context from your stack trace, environment, and affected code to get fast and accurate solutions.
You can chat with this tool collaboratively.
